• **Combo Fighter** comes over, of course. Its AWS is $62/mo now that Blake killed the extra January backend copy. Blake moves the billing by Mar 1, and I take the game when Sunset's sale closes.
• **Domino Delights** comes over too. It made $183.11 in January (warehouse daily revenue table), which covers the $140/mo its prod account bills now. Blake moves that billing by Mar 1, and you take the game through Sunset.
• **Zombie Match** stays with HG. It made $0 in January, so it can't cover its own AWS.
• AppsFlyer free tier for CF from March is on you. DD support is already on email.
• Blake already carries Metabase $100, dbt $100 and GitHub $48 on his card through May.
• Everything else stays with HG: the AWS dev/ZM/analytics accounts, build machines, Figma, Calm Play, and everything we already kept or cancelled in #winddown.

Cost March–May: **$450/mo total**, so **$150/mo each**. Blake's $248 counts toward his third. You and I each put in $150 cash a month. That covers the LLC's $202 in AWS and pays Blake back the $98 he's over.
